Interface CompanyApi

public interface CompanyApi
Reads companies and adds members to them.

Every future completes off the main thread; see CompaniesApi for how to get back onto it.

    • memberStats

      CompletableFuture<List<? extends IMemberStats>> memberStats(int company, TimeRange range)
      What each worker contributed to a company in a time range.

      Workers without a completed order in the range are left out. Former members who contributed are included.

      Parameters:
      company - id of the company
      range - time range of the values
      Returns:
      future of the statistics per worker, empty when the company is unknown or had no activity in the range

    • treasury

      CompletableFuture<Optional<? extends ITreasury>> treasury(int company)
      The treasury of a company: its balance and the share of each payout it keeps. A company that never used its treasury has a balance and share of 0.
      Parameters:
      company - id of the company
      Returns:
      future of the treasury, empty when no company has this id

    • addMember

      CompletableFuture<JoinResult> addMember(int company, UUID player)
      Adds a player to a company, regardless of the company's join mode.

      The member limit of the company's level applies. Open invites and applications of the player are removed. On success a CompanyJoinEvent is fired, so levels and announcements behave as for a player who joined on their own. The player gets no permissions in the company.

      This is a write operation: before Companies is ready the future completes exceptionally with an ApiNotReadyException.

      Parameters:
      company - id of the company
      player - id of the player
      Returns:
      future of the outcome
